title: Assisted Living Absence-Relief Credit: Calculation Note
content:
For one temporary absence under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement, the absence-relief credit is the amount defined below. The dates are the absence start date and the absence return date recorded on the residency.

1. **Midnights away.** The midnights away are the absence return date less the absence start date, counted in calendar days.
2. **Credited days.** The credited days of the absence-relief credit are the midnights away less the waiting midnights, never below zero and never above the maximum days credited for one continuous absence, the waiting midnights being the absence credit waiting period of the leave of absence figures.
3. **Billing month.** The billing month is that of the most recent full-month care fee charge on the residency; its days are the days of that calendar month.
4. **Daily care fee.** The daily care fee of the absence-relief credit is the monthly care fee of the care level the residency carries, divided by the days in the billing month of the most recent full-month care fee charge on the residency. The daily care fee is not rounded on its own.
5. **Credit.** The absence-relief credit is the daily care fee multiplied by the credited days and by the absence credit percentage, rounded once to the cent half up at the end.

### Worked figures (hypothetical residency; leave of absence figures of 14 waiting midnights, 30 maximum days and 100 percent)

The residency carries Assisted Living Care Level 3, whose monthly care fee is 1874.00; the most recent full-month care fee charge is for a 31-day month.

| Absence | Midnights away | Credited days | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 May to 1 June | 29 | 29 less 14, that is 15 | 1874.00 divided by 31, multiplied by 15 and by 100 percent: 906.774… rounded to 906.77 |
| 1 March to 20 April | 50 | 50 less 14 is 36, held at the maximum of 30 | 1874.00 divided by 31, multiplied by 30: 1813.548… rounded to 1813.55 |
| 5 July to 19 July | 14 | 0 | 0.00 |
| 5 July to 20 July | 15 | 1 | 1874.00 divided by 31: 60.451… rounded to 60.45 |

The rounding happens once, on the final product; the daily care fee enters that product unrounded.
